package converted

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"golang.org/x/net/html"
)

func navbarTree(t *testing.T, body string) *html.Node {
	t.Helper()
	tree, err := html.Parse(strings.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return tree
}

func navbarNodes(root *html.Node, tag string) []*html.Node {
	var nodes []*html.Node
	var walk func(*html.Node)
	walk = func(n *html.Node) {
		if n.Type == html.ElementNode && n.Data == tag {
			nodes = append(nodes, n)
		}
		for c := n.FirstChild; c != nil; c = c.NextSibling {
			walk(c)
		}
	}
	walk(root)
	return nodes
}

func navbarAttr(n *html.Node, key string) string {
	for _, a := range n.Attr {
		if a.Key == key {
			return a.Val
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func navbarCanonical(t *testing.T, body string) string {
	t.Helper()
	var b bytes.Buffer
	if err := html.Render(&b, navbarTree(t, body)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return b.String()
}

func TestNavbarReferenceAndTypedDOM(t *testing.T) {
	reference := renderNavbar(t, NavbarReference())
	if navbarCanonical(t, reference) != navbarCanonical(t, navbarSource) {
		t.Fatal("reference differs from original DOM")
	}
	var defaults Navbar
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(navbarDefaults), &defaults); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if defaults.IDPrefix != "" || defaults.Label != "" || defaults.CurrentKey != "" || defaults.Brand.LightURL != "" || defaults.Brand.DarkURL != "" || defaults.Account != nil || defaults.Notifications != nil {
		t.Fatal("defaults invent app authority")
	}
	for _, link := range defaults.Links {
		if link.Key != "" || link.URL != "" {
			t.Fatal("defaults invent routes")
		}
	}
	requireNavbarError(t, defaults)
	data := fixtureNavbar()
	data.CurrentKey = "projects"
	component, err := NewNavbar(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	typed := renderNavbar(t, component)
	tree := navbarTree(t, typed)
	sourceTree := navbarTree(t, navbarSource)
	navs := navbarNodes(tree, "nav")
	if len(navs) != 1 || navbarAttr(navs[0], "aria-label") != data.Label || navbarAttr(navs[0], "class") != navbarAttr(navbarNodes(sourceTree, "nav")[0], "class") {
		t.Fatal("landmark name/source style differs")
	}
	links := navbarNodes(tree, "a")
	sourceLinks := navbarNodes(sourceTree, "a")
	wantURLs := []string{"/dashboard", "https://example.test/projects", "/notifications", "/profile", "/settings", "/dashboard", "https://example.test/projects"}
	if len(links) != len(wantURLs) {
		t.Fatal("wrong typed link count")
	}
	for i, n := range links {
		if navbarAttr(n, "href") != wantURLs[i] {
			t.Fatal("destination/order mismatch")
		}
	}
	for _, pair := range [][2]int{{0, 1}, {1, 0}, {3, 4}, {4, 4}, {5, 8}, {6, 7}} {
		if navbarAttr(links[pair[0]], "class") != navbarAttr(sourceLinks[pair[1]], "class") {
			t.Fatal("source current/default style binding differs")
		}
	}
	var current []int
	for i, n := range links {
		if navbarAttr(n, "aria-current") != "" {
			if navbarAttr(n, "aria-current") != "page" {
				t.Fatal("wrong current semantics")
			}
			current = append(current, i)
		}
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(current, []int{1, 6}) {
		t.Fatal("current route not identical across desktop/mobile")
	}
	buttons := navbarNodes(tree, "button")
	if len(buttons) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("optional navigation became a fake button")
	}
	for _, button := range buttons {
		if navbarAttr(button, "type") != "button" {
			t.Fatal("trigger could submit surrounding form")
		}
	}
	if navbarAttr(buttons[0], "commandfor") != data.IDPrefix+"-mobile" || navbarAttr(buttons[0], "aria-controls") != data.IDPrefix+"-mobile" {
		t.Fatal("mobile trigger target differs")
	}
	disclosures := navbarNodes(tree, "el-disclosure")
	if len(disclosures) != 1 || navbarAttr(disclosures[0], "id") != data.IDPrefix+"-mobile" {
		t.Fatal("disclosure identity differs")
	}
	images := navbarNodes(tree, "img")
	if len(images) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("image inventory differs")
	}
	for i, url := range []string{data.Brand.LightURL, data.Brand.DarkURL, data.Account.ImageURL} {
		if navbarAttr(images[i], "src") != url {
			t.Fatal("image URL binding differs")
		}
		wantAlt := data.Brand.Alt
		if i == 2 {
			wantAlt = ""
		}
		if navbarAttr(images[i], "alt") != wantAlt {
			t.Fatal("image semantics differ")
		}
	}
	if len(navbarNodes(tree, "form")) != 0 || len(navbarNodes(tree, "script")) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("inferred runtime/mutation")
	}
	data.IDPrefix = "second"
	second, err := NewNavbar(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	multiple := typed + renderNavbar(t, second)
	for _, id := range []string{"fixture-nav-mobile", "second-mobile"} {
		if strings.Count(multiple, `id="`+id+`"`) != 1 {
			t.Fatal("repeated instance IDs collide")
		}
	}
	data = fixtureNavbar()
	data.CurrentKey, data.Notifications, data.Account = "", nil, nil
	minimalComponent, err := NewNavbar(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	minimal := renderNavbar(t, minimalComponent)
	minimalTree := navbarTree(t, minimal)
	if len(navbarNodes(minimalTree, "el-dropdown")) != 0 || len(navbarNodes(minimalTree, "el-menu")) != 0 || len(navbarNodes(minimalTree, "button")) != 1 || len(navbarNodes(minimalTree, "a")) != 4 {
		t.Fatal("omitted actions remain interactive")
	}
	data = fixtureNavbar()
	data.Links[0].Label = strings.Repeat("Long route name ", 15)
	data.Account.Links[0].Label = strings.Repeat("Long account route ", 12)
	longComponent, err := NewNavbar(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	outputs := map[string]string{"reference.html": reference, "typed.html": typed, "minimal.html": minimal, "long.html": renderNavbar(t, longComponent), "multiple.html": multiple}
	if navbarOutput != "" {
		for name, body := range outputs {
			if os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(navbarOutput, name), []byte(body), 0600) != nil {
				t.Fatal("private render write failed")
			}
		}
	}
}
